name: Gerizim
overview: Mount Gerizim holds a significant place in biblical history as the designated site for blessing Israel, as commanded by God through Moses and demonstrated during the covenant renewal when half the tribes stood on Gerizim to pronounce blessings (Deuteronomy 11:29; 27:12; Joshua 8:33). It also served as a platform for prophetic proclamation, notably when Jotham addressed the people of Shechem from its summit to expose Abimelech's conspiracy (Judges 9:7). Additionally, Gerizim was recognized by the Samaritans as a sacred place of worship, contrasting with the Jerusalem temple worship emphasized by the Jews (John 4:20).
